WorkflowTypeId.description: A stable unique identifier for the workflow type. Importing a workflow type whose identifier exists saves the import as the next version of that workflow type, discards its draft, and lets running instances finish on the versions they started on.

VersionId.description: Ignored on import: versions belong to the site, and deployment plans do not export it.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the workflow type is enabled. Disabled workflow types never start.

IsSingleton.description: Whether only a single instance of this workflow type can run at a time.

LockTimeout.description: The timeout in milliseconds to acquire a lock before resuming a workflow instance of this type. Only used when 'IsSingleton' is true.

LockExpiration.description: The expiration in milliseconds of the lock acquired before resuming a workflow instance of this type. Only used when 'IsSingleton' is true.

IsSingletonPerCorrelation.description: Whether an event that starts the workflow with a correlation id, such as the id of a content item or a user, does not start a new instance while an instance with the same correlation id waits. Ignored when 'IsSingleton' is true.

DeleteFinishedWorkflows.description: Whether workflow instances are deleted once they complete.

IsActivity.description: Whether other workflows can run this one with the 'ExecuteWorkflowTask', setting its input variables and getting its output variables back. Such a workflow starts with a 'StartedByWorkflowEvent'.

BranchingMode.description: How an outcome that has several transitions is followed: only the first transition, or all of them in the order they were added, which runs several branches without a 'ForkTask'.

FaultOnScriptErrors.description: Whether a script error faults the instance at the activity that ran the script. Otherwise, the run goes on with the fallback value and the error is recorded in the journal.

RecordActivityData.description: Whether the journal records the data of each activity execution: the evaluated expressions, the outputs, the changed variables and the last result. Values can be large or sensitive.

Name.description: The name of the variable: a letter or an underscore, then letters, digits or underscores. Names are unique in a workflow type, ignoring case.

TypeName.description: The type of the variable. Values are converted to it.

DefaultValue.description: The value of the variable when an instance starts. Omit it for none.

Description.description: What the variable is for, shown in the designer.

IsInput.description: Whether the variable is an input, set by a workflow that runs this one as an activity or by a caller that starts the workflow with an input of that name.

IsOutput.description: Whether the variable is an output, returned to a workflow that runs this one as an activity.

Variables.description: The variables the workflow type declares. Activities read them with variable('name') in JavaScript or Workflow.Variables.name in Liquid, set them with the 'SetVariableTask', and write outputs to them with 'OutputBindings'.
